question.question_text: How can you retrieve the multi-colored tent from the bathroom?

answer_options.text: Exit the bathroom, turn right, and walk forward to the staircase. The tent is at the base of the stairs.
Exit the bathroom, turn left, and walk towards the storage room. Turn right into the kitchen, and the tent is on the floor in front of the oven door.
Exit the bathroom and go through the door on the right. Turn right, walk forward, and take the second entrance on the left into the living room. The tent is on the floor next to the couch.
Exit the bathroom and go through the door on the right. Walk forward into the kitchen, and the ball is on the tent in front of the oven door.
Exit the bathroom and go through the door on the right. Turn right and walk forward to the staircase. The tent is at the base of the stairs.
